security_privacy_cost_impact: Security-positive, CI order only: the two checks that would report a compromised or freshly published package now run before any installed package code can prepend a shim to $GITHUB_PATH or edit the checkout. No credential, permission, network target or dependency change; no personal or customer data.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes; CI step order only.
known_limitations: npm ci itself is not covered: it runs with --ignore-scripts, so no package code runs during install, and the residual A1-257-10 records (code the repository itself runs after the guard) is unchanged.

The package-code pattern is a text match on run lines (\bnext\b, \btsc\b, ...); a step that ran package code under another name (e.g. a node script importing a package) would not be recognised. The exact step list in the A1-257-4 test still pins every step.
